presentation.label: Consistent sample previews
presentation.summary: Preview Flex and Static samples at the default AMP volume, even when the active track is turned down.
presentation.overview: Preview Vol makes FUNC+YES and CUE+YES sample previews use the default AMP VOL (internal value 64, shown as 0). The active track's AMP volume is restored when the preview stops. Track FX, main/cue levels and mixer volumes still apply, so this is not loudness normalization. This source draft awaits qualification and owner review.
highlights: Audition samples even when the active track's AMP VOL is turned down.
The same AMP volume override applies to Flex and Static previews.
Main and cue preview shortcuts use the same behavior.
The track's own AMP volume returns when the preview stops.
usage: In a qualified local test build, select an audio track and open a Flex/Static sample slot list, file browser or audio editor.
Select a sample and press FUNC+YES to preview through the main outputs, or CUE+YES through the cue outputs.
Repeat with the active track's AMP VOL turned down; the preview uses its default AMP volume. Stop the preview and verify the track's own AMP volume is restored.

access.location: Automatic when included in a qualified build: Flex/Static sample slot lists, file browser and audio editor; FUNC+YES / CUE+YES previews.
steps: Use a disposable project in a qualified local build; this draft is unavailable in the configurator.
Select an audio track and open a Flex/Static sample slot list, the file browser or the audio editor. Exact panel/menu navigation for each entry point still requires captured verification.
Select a sample and hold FUNC while pressing YES for a main-output preview.
Hold CUE while pressing YES for a cue-output preview.
Repeat at different AMP VOL settings, stop the preview and verify the track's stored AMP volume returns. Track FX and main/cue/mixer levels still affect what you hear.

limitations: Draft only: unavailable in the configurator until qualification, actual OT UI evidence and owner approval are complete.
This changes preview AMP VOL only; it does not normalize sample loudness or bypass track FX, track levels or mixer settings.
No effect slot or dedicated module knob; the automatic USB no-UI exception does not apply.
Upstream emulator tests call preview routines directly. Panel shortcuts, complete entry/stop steps and hardware timing remain unverified.

Native hook placement and compatibility with the approved modules, including Repitch's playback changes, require native composition/rejection and browser byte-parity tests. An empty conflict list makes no tested compatibility claim.
